subject: Azure co-sell readiness & account inventory — Contoso pilot
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@contoso.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Microsoft Marketplace PM <marketplace-pm@microsoft.com>
Cc: Gavin Thomas <gavin.thomas@contoso.com>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure co-sell readiness & account inventory — Contoso pilot

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are kicking off a Contoso pilot for Azure Marketplace + co-sell and want to make sure we are set from Partner Center referral ingestion through seller alignment. High level asks:

- Confirm what fields Redwood needs for Partner Center referral ingestion (MSFT referral id, account tenant id, primary contact, opportunity stage).
- Walk us through how you reconcile Partner Center referrals to field sellers (what is the source of truth for owner mapping?).
- Share a minimal readiness checklist so our GTM and sales ops teams can get us into a releasable state this quarter.

I attached our current account list (sanitized) and an internal Owner map. Can you review and let us know the gaps?

Appreciate it — can we aim to have an initial alignment call this week?

Best,
Maria Lopez\Head of Cloud Partnerships, Contoso
[Attachment: contoso_account_inventory_20280514.csv (text/csv)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell readiness & account inventory — Contoso pilot

Maria — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. I pulled together a concise co-sell readiness checklist and an owner-reconciliation approach (attached). Quick answers up front:

- Required referral fields: MSFT_referral_id, partner_id, customer_tenant_id, contact_email, estimated ARR, opportunity_stage, geo. We also recommend including an initial seller_hint (email or seller alias) to speed routing.
- Owner mapping: primary source is Partner Center "seller_assigned" field + Azure CRM owner table; when those disagree we use last-contacted-by and a manual claim workflow that CS/AMs can resolve.
- Minimal checklist (attached): partner onboarding record, marketplace SKU mapping, Partner Center consent verified, seller consent captured, referral ingest test, and a one-week monitoring window after first production referral.

Action items I propose:
1) Vanessa to validate seller roster for Contoso accounts (step 2).
2) Karthik to scope a lightweight ingest validator script to flag missing referral fields and tenant mismatches.
3) Contoso to confirm preferred owners in the attached inventory sheet.

I attached: 2028-05-14_contoso_cosell_readiness_checklist.xlsx (checklist + mapping template) and a redlined copy of your inventory with suggested owner hints.

Irene
Irene Choi\Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
M: +1 (415) 555-0136
[Attachment: 2028-05-14_contoso_cosell_readiness_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Great packet, Irene and Maria. A couple of practical notes from field ops based on the inventory you shared:

- There are ~18 accounts in the list that have ambiguous ownership (two seller aliases present, no Partner Center claim). I'll tag those in the shared Drive sheet under the "contested" tab.
- For the seller_hint column: please put the seller alias (sfdc username) + region. That helps our PC referral router take an initial pass before manual claim.
- We should run a short "consent sweep" (ask sellers to accept Partner Center consent) for the 30 highest ARR accounts before turning on auto-routing. That reduces downstream triage.

Next steps:
- I updated the Drive sheet: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_contoso_cosell_inventory (see tabs: owner_roster, contested, ingest_flags).
- Can Contoso confirm owners for the contested tab by EOD Wednesday? If not, we'll run an interim rule: prioritize seller with most recent activity in CRM.

Vanessa Ortiz\Senior Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0210

Thanks — solid alignment. A few technical commitments from infra/eng:

- I will deliver an ingest-validator script by EOD Thursday (2028-05-18) that checks for missing Partner Center fields, tenant id mismatches, and returns a confidence score for seller attribution. Output: CSV with columns [referral_id, tenant_id, ingest_ok, seller_confidence, issues].
- For contested ownership, we can add a transient "claim_token" into the referral metadata; once a seller clicks claim (link we generate) the referral re-routes to that seller. That should cut manual work for the top accounts. ETA for claim flow prototype: 2 weeks.
- I'll need a small list of API credentials from Contoso to test tenant lookups (read-only). Maria — can you share a minimal test service principal and one test tenant?

I'll also add a flag in telemetry so ops can see how many referrals fail ingest vs are contested. Vanessa — if you can maintain the contested tab, I'll wire the script to post results to that sheet each run.

Karthik
